summary_short.zh: Open Notebook 是一个开源的智能笔记工具，旨在替代 NotebookLM，帮助你更高效地学习和整理知识。它利用 AI 自动组织笔记、生成摘要，并跨文档关联想法。其核心优势在于高度灵活：你可以自定义工作流、接入本地模型，并完全掌控自己的数据。无论是做研究、复习备考，还是构建个人知识库，你都可以克隆仓库、本地运行，亲手打造一个 AI 增强的笔记本。

summaries.en: Open Notebook is an open-source alternative to NotebookLM, designed to help you take smarter notes and learn more effectively. It uses AI to organize your notes, generate summaries, and connect ideas across documents. What makes it special is its flexibility—you can customize workflows, integrate with local models, and control your data. Try it for research, study, or personal knowledge management; clone the repo, run it locally, and start building your own AI-powered notebook.

summary_short.zh: Copilot SDK 是一个多平台 Java 库，旨在让开发者轻松将 GitHub Copilot 的 AI 代码补全能力集成到自己的应用和服务中。其核心技术亮点是将 Copilot Agent 的复杂协议抽象为简洁、可复用的 API，自动处理认证、流式响应和上下文管理，大大降低了接入门槛。你可以用它快速构建自定义 IDE 插件、智能聊天界面或自动化代码审查工具，无需从头实现底层通信。无论是增强现有开发环境，还是打造全新的 AI 辅助编程体验，这个 SDK 都提供了坚实的起点。

summaries.en: Copilot SDK is a multi-platform Java library that enables developers to integrate GitHub Copilot's AI-powered code completion into their own applications and services. Its key technical strength lies in abstracting the Copilot Agent protocol into a clean, reusable API, handling authentication, streaming responses, and context management. You can use it to build custom IDE plugins, chat interfaces, or automated code review tools that leverage Copilot's capabilities without reinventing the wheel.

summary_short.zh: OpenClaw Windows Node是OpenClaw在Windows平台的伴侣套件，通过系统托盘应用、共享库、Node.js绑定和PowerToys命令面板扩展，实现强大的剪贴板管理。它解决跨设备同步、历史搜索和高效粘贴等痛点，模块化设计便于开发者集成或扩展。技术亮点在于共享库与Node绑定提供灵活API，使非.NET应用也能调用核心功能。用户可直接使用系统托盘应用体验无缝管理，或利用API构建自定义剪贴板增强工具。

summaries.en: OpenClaw Windows Node is a companion suite that brings OpenClaw's clipboard management to Windows via a system tray app, shared library, Node.js bindings, and a PowerToys Command Palette extension. It enables seamless clipboard history, search, and sync across devices. The modular architecture allows developers to integrate clipboard functionality into their own tools or extend it with custom plugins. Try it to supercharge your clipboard workflow or build new utilities on top of its API.
